title: Mera Kadiyal Jawaan Beta Kaha Hai
body:
Sare Maqtal Ye Sarwar Ki Fughaa Hai
mera Kadiyal Jawaan Beta Kaha Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Mai Khata Hu Yaha Thokar Pe Thokar
sada Apni Sunade Mere Dilbar
zaeefi Me Ye Kaisa Imtehaan Hai
<<MINI>>
mera Kadiyal Jawaan Beta Kaha Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Sujhai Kuch Nahi Deta Hai Mujhko
dikhai Kuch Nahi Deta Hai Mujhko
pukaru Kis Tarah Zakhmi Zubaan Hai
<<MINI>>
mera Kadiyal Jawaan Beta Kaha Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
3.mujhe Aawaz Apni Tum Sunado
mere Laal Aao Mujhko Aasra Do
meri Jaan Meri Aankhon Me Dhua Hai
<<MINI>>
mera Kadiyal Jawaan Beta Kaha Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Abhi To Tum Gale Mil Kar Gaye The
mai Kaise Bhulu Tum Kitne Ho Pyase
kaleje Par Mere Khanjar Rawaan Hai
<<MINI>>
mera Kadiyal Jawaan Beta Kaha Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Pata Tera Mai Sabse Puchta Hu
tadap Kar Peet Kar Sar Kehraha Hu
mai Budha Hu Mera Beta Jawan Hai
<<MINI>>
mera Kadiyal Jawaan Beta Kaha Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Taras Khata Nahi Ab Koi Mujhpar
mai Rota Hu To Haste Hai Sitamgar
ye Lagta Hai Ke Ab Hoto Pe Jaan Hai
<<MINI>>
mera Kadiyal Jawaan Beta Kaha Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Jhulasti Dhoop Me Aada Ne Milkar
na Jaane Kia Sitam Dhaya Hai Tujhpar
mere Dil Me Khatakti Kyu Sina Hai
<<MINI>>
mera Kadiyal Jawaan Beta Kaha Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Kaleja Ho Raha Hai Mera Tukde
mai Pyaasa Hu Mere Aansu Hai Pyase
lahu Aankho Me Meri Ab Rawa Hai
<<MINI>>
mera Kadiyal Jawaan Beta Kaha Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Kaho Kia Umme Laila Se Mai Bolo
tumhare Biyaah Ka Armaan Tha Usko ke Maroofe Dua Uski Dua Hai
<<MINI>>
mera Kadiyal Jawaan Beta Kaha Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
10. Batao Kaise Laila Ko Manaun
mai Tanha Khaime Me Kis Tarha Jaun
bohot Bechain Akbar Teri Maa Hai
<<MINI>>
mera Kadiyal Jawaan Beta Kaha Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
11. Phuphi Teri Dar E Khaima Pe Hogi
kahu Kia Usse Mai Rudaad Teri
wo Gar Puche Mera Akbar Kaha Hai
<<MINI>>
mera Kadiyal Jawaan Beta Kaha Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
12. Zara Aao Phuphi Ka Haal Dekho ke Aththara Baras Pala Hai Tumko
musalsal Uske Hoto Per Fughan Hai
<<MINI>>
mera Kadiyal Jawaan Beta Kaha Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
13. Sakina Ki Mohabbat Jante Ho
tasalli Kaise Du Batlao Usko
wo Puchegi Mera Bhaiyya Kaha Hai
<<MINI>>
mera Kadiyal Jawaan Beta Kaha Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
14. Rasheed Ab Kaise Likhu Shah Ki Ghurbat
jo Tooti Jaan E Zahra Par Qayamat
musibat Karwaan Dar Karwaan Hai
<<MINI>>
mera Kadiyal Jawaan Beta Kaha Hai
